interpretation_boundary.euas_question: Which event family is the strongest demonstrated joint laboratory when asymmetry, timing, linked-asset sensitivity, liquidity, sampleability, resolution, observability and penalties are considered together?
interpretation_boundary.ias_future_question: Which event family has the strongest structural information-asymmetry potential under a separately frozen protocol?

workstreams.goal: Re-account the already frozen economic rules as a financed portfolio with explicit overlap, capital, NAV, exposures, turnover and portfolio risk metrics.
workstreams.research_recommendation: Funded accounting reconstruction of the exact R1 primary trade set; first gate is exact legacy PnL reconciliation, not profitability.

workstreams.goal: Create a pure structural information-asymmetry protocol distinct from EUAS feasibility/laboratory quality.
workstreams.research_recommendation: Formative IAS profile with separate evidence confidence, independent feasibility gates, synthetic pre-validation and global weight/rank robustness via SMAA.

workstreams.goal: Expand performance-blind discovery and manual validation for granular high-asymmetry candidate event families after the IAS/discovery protocol is frozen.
candidate_discovery_channels_not_frozen: bounded keyset crawl with fail-closed guards
workstreams.coverage_rule: Store all discovery-channel provenance per event; low discovery counts never imply zero asymmetry or family absence.

workstreams.goal: Run a new independently preregistered experiment only if an alternative family passes ex-ante asymmetry and feasibility gates.

global_prohibitions: No family selection using ARGOS performance.
No IAS scoring using ARGOS outcome, return, Brier, log loss or PnL.
No post-outcome threshold, subgroup, feature, horizon, sizing or capital-base selection presented as confirmatory.
No invented PIT borrow fee, microstructure history or other unavailable data.
No replacement of the QA-approved PDF baseline without a new hash and complete QA.
next_action: Draft and adversarially review the W2A funded-accounting protocol and the W2B IAS/W2C discovery protocol using synthetic validation only; freeze both before computing new portfolio outputs, expanded census evidence used for scoring, or real IAS family scores.
